plugins.name: workiq
plugins.description: Full WorkIQ tool surface for Microsoft 365 — agentic queries via ask plus direct reads and writes across mail, calendar, Teams, files, people, and Planner. Organized as a hub-and-domain skill hierarchy: a tool-surface hub routes to one domain skill per M365 surface, plus cross-domain workflows and always-on trust and safety rules.

plugins.name: workiq-preview
plugins.description: Preview build: full WorkIQ tool surface — agentic queries via ask plus direct reads and writes (create, update, delete, send) across emails, meetings, calendar, Planner tasks, documents, Teams, people and contacts, OneDrive, and SharePoint.

plugins.name: microsoft-365-agents-toolkit
plugins.description: Toolkit for building and evaluating Microsoft 365 Copilot declarative agents — scaffolding, JSON manifest development, capability configuration, and eval workflows.
